name: io.github.user-github-me/soniccraft
title: SonicCraft
description: Compile timelines of TTS speech, music and SFX into ducked, loudness-mastered audio with subtitles

runtimeArguments.name: --mount
runtimeArguments.description: Host directory mounted at /work: timelines and assets are read from it and renders are written to it (as uid 1000)

work_dir.description: Absolute path of the host directory with your timelines and audio assets

packageArguments.description: Run the SonicCraft MCP server on stdio

packageArguments.name: --base-dir
packageArguments.description: Resolve relative timeline, asset and output paths against the mounted directory

environmentVariables.name: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: ElevenLabs API key for the elevenlabs TTS provider (optional)

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key for the openai TTS provider (optional)

environmentVariables.name: CARTESIA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Cartesia API key for the cartesia TTS provider (optional)
